gloss: to not make sense; to not sit right; to not be convincing

definitions.gloss: to not make sense; to not sit right; to not be convincing; to not feel right
definitions.explanation: Describes a feeling of not being fully convinced or satisfied with an explanation, decision, or situation. Something about it feels off or unreasonable, even if one cannot pinpoint exactly why.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{腑|ふ}に{落|お}ちない。
examples.english: His explanation doesn't make sense to me.
There are several points that don't sit right with me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{腑|ふ}に{落|お}ちない⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: I understand the reason, but somehow there's a part that just doesn't feel right.

notes:
{腑|ふ} refers to the internal organs (especially the gut), reflecting the Japanese cultural idea that understanding and intuition are felt in the belly. When something {腑|ふ}に{落|お}ちない, it literally "doesn't fall into the gut" — the explanation hasn't been digested or internalized.

The affirmative form ⟦{腑|ふ}に{落|お}ちる→腑に落ちる：09908_funiochiru⟧ (to make sense, to click) is also used but less common than the negative.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {腑|ふ}に{落|お}ちない⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧: an unconvincing explanation
- {腑|ふ}に{落|お}ちない⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧: a point that doesn't add up
- ⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{腑|ふ}に{落|お}ちない: something just doesn't sit right
- ⟦{腑|ふ}に{落|お}ちる→腑に落ちる：09908_funiochiru⟧: to make sense; to click (affirmative)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{納得|なっとく}がいかない→納得がいかない：19533_nattokugaikanai⟧: to not be satisfied; to not accept — more about refusing to accept than gut feeling
- ⟦ぴんとこない→ピンとこない：09367_pintokonai⟧: to not click; to not resonate — more casual; implies lack of intuitive understanding
- {合点|がてん}がいかない: to not be convinced — similar but more literary
